683:t_030:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Big Sis... I never got to tell you my last words...)

683:t_030:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Big Sis... I never got to tell you my last words...)

683:t_030:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Big Sis... I never got to tell you my last words...)

683:t_030:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught $$ノノ$$...!)

683:t_030:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught $$ノノ$$...!)

683:t_030:9.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(But $$ノノ$$ will fight...! With the hard work and guts $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis taught $$ノノ$$...!)

683:t_031:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is bad! The fronts around here are collapsing one after another, and $$宇宙怪獣$$ are pouring into this area, I'm told!」

683:t_031:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「More enemy reinforcements, at a time like this!」

683:t_031:2.en:
$$レド$$
「At this rate, before we can take down that variable gravity source, $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 will...!」

683:t_032:1.en:
$n
「This is bad! At this rate, $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is in trouble!」

683:t_033:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「She shielded $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 with her own body!」

683:t_033:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But even a tough machine like $$ダイバスター$$ won't survive if it keeps taking attacks like that...!」

683:t_033:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$ was born to do this, after all...」

683:t_033:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$ was born to do this, after all...」

683:t_033:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「It's all right... $$ノノ$$ was born to do this, after all...」

683:t_034:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$! Is that the Princess!?」

683:t_034:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You saved me, pal. Thanks for bringing me all the way here.」

683:t_034:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Thank you. Your life... I'll make use of it.」

683:t_035:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ has taken in the $$バスター軍団$$'s degeneracy reactor!」

683:t_035:1.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Now that it has regained the degeneracy reactor removed thousands of years ago and freed the true cockpit hidden in its artificial brain, $$ディスヌフ$$ reveals its true form!」

683:t_035:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's do this, $$ディスヌフ$$!!」

683:t_036:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$'s true form!?」

683:t_037:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is... $$バスターマシン１９号$$!!」

683:t_039:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Being grateful for painful, agonizing things is just stupid!」

683:t_039:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're always like this! Even when you lose out, you're so earnest and reckless...!」

683:t_039:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But that's what being human is!」

683:t_039:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Strength isn't about the size of your body! It's the power of the heart! Isn't that right, $$ノノ$$! That is... hard work and guts!!」

683:t_040:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes, Big Sis!」

683:t_041:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's Friendship Lightning Kick!」

683:t_041:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's Friendship Lightning Kick!」

683:t_041:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Of course it is! It's $$ノノ$$ and Big Sis's Friendship Lightning Kick!」

683:t_041:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It suits you, $$ラルク$$. That combat suit of the $$トップ部隊$$...」

683:t_041:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-It's just what was in $$ディスヌフ$$'s cockpit...」

683:t_041:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Along with that outfit, you inherited the spirit of the $$トップ部隊$$.」

683:t_041:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Through your hard work and guts.」

683:t_041:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Not a bad ring to it.」

683:t_041:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Each of you alone is just a fire...」

683:t_041:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But put two together and you become a blaze!」

683:t_041:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That goes for more than just you two!」
